purpose: Executable evidence index for protected legacy behavior during Wave 0. These vectors do not claim that later-wave target journeys are implemented.

executionContract.rule: Every adapterTests path must exist and is executed by the repository test suite; numeric golden assertions are executed by wave0GoldenReconciliation.test.ts.

vectors.name: Opening stock and purchase receipt preserve MWA
Posted sale freezes historical COGS and decreases inventory
Customer collection reduces receivable and moves treasury exactly once
expected: retry does not duplicate economic effect

vectors.name: Sales return restores original historical cost after current average changes
preconditions: later receipt changes current average to 113

vectors.name: Reversal retains original history and compensates once
expected: second retry does not create a second economic reversal

vectors.name: Purchase receipt plus supplier payment reconciles inventory, supplier ledger, treasury and GL
expected: receipt increases stock/value using current costing rules
supplier payable increases then decreases by payment

vectors.name: Purchase return preserves defined historical valuation and supplier effect
expected: stock/value decrease follows stored historical policy

vectors.name: Treasury movement replay owns financial account balance
expected: financial movement signed deltas reproduce currentBalance

vectors.name: COD delivery and settlement keep operational status separate from financial authority
expected: COD financial effects are represented by finance/ledger records
shipment status alone is not a posting

vectors.name: Repair part consumption preserves inventory cost and accounting bridge
expected: cost is tied to repair source

vectors.name: Cost and profit remain server-redacted for roles without permission
expected: backend/DTO does not expose protected cost/profit
UI hiding is not the only control

vectors.name: Migration rehearsal preserves explicit control totals and fails closed on invalid data
expected: invalid records are reported rather than silently altered

vectors.name: Historical reporting uses historical COGS rather than current product cost
expected: historical COGS is frozen from posted documents
revenue is not equated with collections

deferredReferenceJourneys.reason: The acceptance reference assumes true Company/Tenant setup. Current legacy branch/auth behavior is preserved, but Tenant/Company implementation belongs to Wave 2.
Tax Engine and ETA eInvoice/eReceipt belong to Waves 5-6 and are explicitly out of Wave 0 scope.
Local Server/WAN operation belongs to Wave 7 and is explicitly out of Wave 0 scope.
Same-SHA release acceptance remains a release discipline requirement; Wave 0 records it but does not claim a General Release gate.
